name: @openllmsh/dsh
description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle that routes the harness through the OpenLLM gateway — an `openllm` provider on the in-box pi-ai adapter (via the local daemon gateway) plus the OpenLLM MCP server. Pure config; install OpenLLM first (see README).
//dshRuntimeRequires: Provided by the host DeepSeek Harness at runtime (their preview npm graph pulls the unpublished @deepseek-ai/dsh-environment, so they are not installed here): @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai, @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client. This bundle only patches them via cordis.patch.yml.
